matched_rules.because: A planned system upgrade is in progress and the signals show server temperatures rising above optimal, which is consistent with a contractor control action affecting cooling equipment such as closing chilled-water buffer tank valves.

next_actions.action: Verify that contractor-issued signals cannot close valves on chilled-water buffer tanks or otherwise isolate the chilled-water loop; confirm the actual valve position on the buffer tanks directly, not only from the control system indication; if valves have been closed, treat the chilled-water loop as losing its buffer and act to restore flow before temperatures rise.

escalate.to: facility operations lead and cooling plant engineer
escalate.reason: Contractor control action during an upgrade is suspected to have changed the state of chilled-water buffer tank valves, and server temperatures are already rising above optimal operating conditions.

not_covered: No rule addresses a planned system upgrade with rising server temperatures when the specific cause (e.g., contractor valve closure) is not yet confirmed; R-015 requires confirmation of contractor control action affecting buffer tank valves, which is not yet established.

per_finding.note: R-015 explicitly names contractor control action closing chilled-water buffer tank valves during a planned upgrade as the suspected cause.
The triage does not mention failed access attempts or unsuccessful payment/ATM transactions.
The triage does not address backup data center reachability or network misconfiguration.
The triage does not reference MAS downtime limits or regulatory thresholds.
